notes: Truckly (truckly.dk) is a Danish food-truck tool, unrelated to the US app Truckly LLC (truckly.io). preorder marked partial: the site shows an events/booking module (catering bookings), not explicitly pre-orders for a later day. NemTakeAway: kds and domain are Medium-only (partial); vans is the paid "Hovedkontor" add-on (+499 kr./md. for 2-10 businesses); the priser page itself carries no moms statement, the homepage does. Two eligible priced vendors found (1 food_truck + 1 restaurant), so the POS players (Zettle, SumUp, Lightspeed) were not re-checked. Searches turned up no other Danish food-truck ordering tool; Lejfoodtruck.dk / Mobilmad.dk are truck-booking marketplaces (not opened, not recorded).
